title: SELF_SERVICE login can read entire master/config surface (vendors incl GSTIN+contacts, companies, departments, categories, brands, cost-centres, custom-fields of both companies, code-rules, bundles)
component: backend/app/masters/router.py:125 list_items (Depends get_current_asset_user); masters/custom_fields_router.py:29; numbering/router.py:52; bundles/router.py:24
summary: Master/config LIST endpoints gated only by get_current_asset_user, so SELF_SERVICE (a store or single-laptop holder) reads company-wide and cross-company config + vendor GSTIN/contact PII. People/reports/asset-users deliberately use require_role(READ_ROLES) which excludes SELF_SERVICE; masters do not.
fix: Gate the master/config list routes with require_role(*READ_ROLES) instead of get_current_asset_user; if a dropdown truly needs SELF_SERVICE access expose a narrow purpose-built endpoint.
regression_test: test_self_service_cannot_list_masters: SELF_SERVICE GET each master/config list -> 403; VIEWER -> 200

title: GET /api/masters/custom-fields not company-scoped: returns all companies' custom-field definitions to any authenticated non-ADMIN (cross-company)
summary: Unlike sibling company-owned masters (cost-centres/locations) whose list_items pins non-ADMIN reads to scoped_company_ids, the bespoke custom-fields list returns company_ids [1,2] to SECOPIT/SECOTHER/SECVIEW/SECSELF alike, leaking the other company's field definitions. Contradicts migration 370399c6380e_custom_field_company_scope.
fix: In list_custom_fields filter by scoped_company_ids(session, actor) for non-ADMIN (own-company + global rows); mirror list_items SCOPE_COMPANY_ID narrowing.
regression_test: test_custom_fields_list_company_scoped: CKSPL operator sees only company_id==1; CKVPL operator only ==2; ADMIN all
